dependency_manifests.purpose: Runtime dependencies for the GUI and its directly invoked application features.

packages.numpy: Array operations used by Touka evaluation and image-processing features.
packages.Pillow: Image loading, preview, conversion, and mask handling in application features.
packages.opencv-python-headless: Touka frame/image processing without a bundled OpenCV GUI runtime.
packages.requests: HTTP transport for ComfyUI, A1111, Tagger, and Ollama API clients.
packages.psutil: Optional process affinity and resource controls used by CPU-limiting features.

dependency_manifests.purpose: Image and dataset processing dependencies installed separately from the GUI runtime.

packages.numpy: Array and tensor preparation for image processing and dataset construction.
packages.Pillow: Image, mask, and dataset file loading and saving.
packages.opencv-python-headless: Image and video-frame processing in Touka tools.

dependency_manifests.purpose: Build-only dependencies; this manifest is not part of the application's runtime requirements.

packages.PyInstaller: Freezes the application into the Windows one-directory distribution.
